label: caiso per-hub legs + solar-shape (PROBE)
definition: PROBE — per-hub signed legs (--caiso-per-hub-intertie) WITH --caiso-import-solar-shape still ON, to test whether the solar-shape proxy still adds anything once the measured per-hub Palo Verde hub is doing the work. Verdict: REDUNDANT. Nearly byte-identical to the per-hub-signed keeper on every axis (2024 mean 43.49 vs 43.82, neg 535 vs 459, net −32.65 vs −32.39, corr −0.17 vs −0.15; 2025 mean 44.55 vs 44.86, net −41.48 vs −41.11, corr −0.38 vs −0.36). solar-shape was a no-OASIS proxy that collapsed the desert-SW import offer toward −$20 to manufacture the negative midday tail; the measured per-hub hub now prints that tail directly, and on a signed node the −$20 import offer mildly re-inflates the very midday over-import the per-hub legs fix (slightly worse corr, +76 neg-hrs). Confirms dropping solar-shape from the keeper (rule #11: prefer the measured input over the proxy). Not a keeper.
